annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于深化投资审批制度改革的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Deepening the Reform of the Investment Approval System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office opinions (Guobanfa [2026] No. 13) on deepening investment approval reform: allocating approval powers, tightening government project approval, regulating enterprise project approval and filing, streamlining procedures, bidding, full-process supervision, evaluation. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Optimise allocation of government investment project approval powers across central, provincial, city and county levels
Strict approval procedures and lifetime accountability for government investment decisions
Dynamic revision of the enterprise project approval catalogue; filing and approval coordinated with industrial policy
Integrated 'one-matter' approval and data sharing via online investment project platform
Full-process supervision, credit records and post-evaluation of investment projects
